faqs.question: What if the baraat runs past 8 hours?
faqs.answer: Extra time is billed per hour at the package rate. Driving after 10 PM adds a night allowance for the driver.

faqs.question: How early should I book?

faqs.question: Can you send the car to a wedding outside Patna?

faqs.question: Can I pay in cash?

You get edited photos online first, and a printed album if you add one. Drone shots can be added where the venue and local rules allow. Tell us the date, venue, number of functions and hours, and we confirm the team and final price before you pay the advance.

faqs.question: When do we get photos and video?
faqs.answer: Edited photos usually come first and the film later. We confirm exact delivery dates with the team at booking.

faqs.question: Can you shoot with a drone?
faqs.answer: Yes, as an add-on, if the venue allows it and the area is not restricted. Areas near Patna airport may need special permission.

faqs.question: What is the difference between candid and traditional?
faqs.answer: Traditional means posed group photos and full ritual coverage. Candid means natural, unposed moments. Most families book both.

faqs.question: How much advance do we pay?
faqs.answer: A part payment blocks the date; the rest is due on or before the event. Exact split is set at booking.

faqs.question: Do you cover weddings outside Patna?
faqs.answer: Yes, across nearby Bihar. Travel and stay are charged extra.

faqs.question: Real or artificial flowers?
faqs.answer: Both are available. Marigold and artificial flowers keep cost low. Roses, orchids and imported flowers cost more and are priced on the day's market rate.

faqs.question: Can you decorate at my home or terrace?
faqs.answer: Yes. Haldi, mehndi, tilak and small wedding setups are done at homes, terraces and community halls. Share photos of the space first.

faqs.question: Does my venue allow outside decorators?
faqs.answer: Many banquet halls have their own decorator or charge a fee for outside teams. Check with the venue; we can talk to them for you.

faqs.question: When does setup start and who removes it?
faqs.answer: Setup starts a few hours before the event. Our team removes everything after the event at no extra cost.

faqs.question: Can I see the design before booking?
faqs.answer: Yes. We share reference photos of the stage and mandap and confirm colours and flowers before taking the advance.

venue-booking.fullDescription: Tell us your date, guest count, veg or non-veg menu and budget per plate. We shortlist banquet halls, lawns and hotel halls in Patna and nearby areas (Danapur, Bailey Road, Kankarbagh, Digha and more), check if your date is free, and arrange site visits. Most venues charge per plate for food, and some add a hall rent or a minimum guest count. Decor, DJ and rooms may be included or extra. We put all this in one clear quote so you can compare venues before paying the booking amount.

faqs.question: Is the per-plate price the full cost?
faqs.answer: Not always. Taxes are usually extra, and some venues add hall rent or a minimum number of plates. We show every charge in the quote.

faqs.question: Can I bring my own caterer or decorator?
faqs.answer: It depends on the venue. Many halls allow only their own caterer or charge a fee for outside teams. We check this for you.

faqs.question: How early should we book?
faqs.answer: For the main wedding season, book a few months ahead because good dates fill fast.

faqs.question: Do I pay TiptoBook or the venue?

faqs.question: Do you cover venues outside Patna city?

faqs.question: Is there a minimum number of guests?

faqs.question: Can the menu be changed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Swap dishes within the same package level. Adding costlier items like mutton or extra counters raises the per-plate price.

faqs.question: Do you serve satvik food for puja or shraddh bhoj?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can cook without onion and garlic and keep a separate veg kitchen on request.

faqs.question: How much advance is needed?
faqs.answer: A part payment confirms the date; the rest is paid on or after the event, online via Razorpay or in cash.

faqs.question: What if more guests come than planned?
faqs.answer: Tell us the final count 48 hours before. Extra plates on the day are charged at the same per-plate rate, subject to availability.

faqs.question: Are waiters included?
faqs.answer: Yes, serving staff are part of every package. Staff count depends on the guest count.

faqs.question: Can I book a Maithili or Bhojpuri-speaking pandit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pick your language at booking. We match you with a pandit who knows your family's vidhi, subject to availability on your date.

faqs.question: What is included in "with samagri"?
faqs.answer: A full kit for that puja: roli, akshat, kalash items, havan samagri, ghee, camphor, dhoop and similar. Fresh fruit, flowers and milk may need to be arranged by you; we confirm the list.

faqs.question: Does the pandit fix the muhurat?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us the event and your preferred dates. The pandit checks the panchang and suggests a time before you confirm.

faqs.question: Can I give extra dakshina?
faqs.answer: You may give extra dakshina or daan by custom. It is your choice and is not required by TiptoBook.

faqs.question: Is there a charge to change the date?
faqs.answer: Free date changes up to 24 hours before the puja. Changes during peak lagan season depend on pandit availability.

faqs.question: Do you do pind daan at Gaya?
faqs.answer: Not in this package. Home shraddh is covered here; Gaya pind daan will be listed as a separate service.

faqs.question: Do I need to provide cleaning material?

faqs.question: How many days off does the helper get?

faqs.question: Can I change tasks later?

faqs.question: What if I am not happy with the helper?
faqs.answer: Tell us. We will try to send a different helper; the plan amount carries over.

home-nurse-gnm-b-sc-12-hrs.title: Home nurse (GNM/B.Sc, 12 hrs)
home-nurse-gnm-b-sc-12-hrs.description: Injections, IV, dressings, catheter/Ryles tube care, vitals

excludes: Medical equipment rental (bed, oxygen concentrator, wheelchair)

faqs.question: What is the difference between an attendant and a nurse?
faqs.answer: An attendant handles daily needs like bathing, feeding and walking. A nurse is trained for medical tasks like injections, IV lines and wound care.

faqs.question: Is the caregiver verified?
faqs.answer: Yes. We check government ID, address and police record before the first shift.

faqs.question: Can I get a female attendant for my mother?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mention it while booking and we will match a female caregiver.

faqs.question: What does the live-in attendant need from us?
faqs.answer: Meals and a place to sleep. They take short rest breaks during the day.

faqs.question: Can I book for just a few days after hospital discharge?
faqs.answer: Yes. Daily billing is available; monthly plans cost less per day.

faqs.question: What if the caregiver takes leave?
faqs.answer: We try to send a replacement for the same shift so care is not interrupted.

laundry-ironing.name: Laundry & Ironing Services
laundry-ironing.shortDescription: Ironing, wash & fold and dry cleaning with free pickup and drop at your door in Patna.
laundry-ironing.fullDescription: Hand over your clothes at the door and get them back clean, pressed and packed. Choose steam ironing per piece, wash & fold or wash & iron by weight, or dry cleaning for sarees, suits, blazers and woollens. Clothes are weighed or counted in front of you at pickup, so you see the bill before we leave. Regular wash returns in about 48 hours; dry cleaning takes 2–4 days. Tell us about stains or delicate fabrics in the booking notes. Pay online or in cash at delivery.
bullets: Free pickup and drop above the minimum order
Weight or piece count shown at your door before pickup
Separate wash per customer; whites sorted from colours
Steam ironing, wash & fold, wash & iron, dry cleaning in one booking
Clothes returned folded or on hangers

steam-ironing-press-only-regular.title: Steam ironing (press only) — Regular
steam-ironing-press-only-regular.description: Shirts, trousers, kurtas, tops: per piece. Returned next day. Min order 20 pieces.

steam-ironing-press-only-saree-bedsheet.title: Steam ironing (press only) — Saree/Bedsheet
steam-ironing-press-only-saree-bedsheet.description: Sarees and bedsheets, per piece. Returned next day. Min order 20 pieces.

wash-and-fold-by-kg.title: Wash & Fold (by kg)
wash-and-fold-by-kg.description: Machine wash, dry, fold. ~48 hrs turnaround. Min 4 kg.

wash-and-iron-by-kg.title: Wash & Iron (by kg)
wash-and-iron-by-kg.description: Wash, dry, steam press, hanger/fold. ~48–72 hrs. Min 4 kg.

excludes: Heavy items (blanket, razai, curtains, carpets) priced per item

faqs.question: How do you charge for wash & fold?
faqs.answer: By weight. The pickup person weighs your clothes at your door and shows you the amount before leaving.

faqs.question: How long does it take?
faqs.answer: Ironing comes back the next day. Wash & fold or wash & iron takes about two days. Dry cleaning takes two to four days.

faqs.question: Are my clothes washed with others'?
faqs.answer: No. Each order is washed separately and tagged so nothing gets mixed up.

faqs.question: Can you remove all stains?
faqs.answer: We treat stains you point out, but old or set stains may not fully come out. We will tell you if one stays.

faqs.question: What if a garment is damaged or lost?
faqs.answer: Report it at delivery. Compensation follows our laundry policy.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum order?
faqs.answer: Yes, 4 kg for wash orders or 20 pieces for ironing to get free pickup and drop.

home-cctv.name: Home CCTV Setup
home-cctv.shortDescription: Wired CCTV fitting for your house with DVR, hard disk and live view on your phone.
home-cctv.fullDescription: A technician visits, checks where cameras are needed, and fits 2, 4 or 8 wired cameras with a recorder (DVR, or NVR for IP cameras). Cables are run along walls or through existing conduit, the hard disk is formatted, recording is switched on, and the brand app is set up on your phone so you can watch live and play back footage. You can buy a camera kit through us (CP Plus, Hikvision or Dahua) or give us cameras you already bought. Labour is priced per package; hardware and extra cable are billed separately.
bullets: Site check and camera position plan before drilling
Camera mounting, cable routing, DVR/NVR and hard disk setup
Recording, motion alerts and mobile app live view set up on up to 2 phones
Short demo: how to see playback and download a clip
Works with CP Plus, Hikvision, Dahua and similar brands

4-camera-install.description: Mount 4 cameras, up to 60 m cable laying, DVR + HDD setup, app on 2 phones

8-camera-install.title: 8-camera install

hardware-kit-2-cam-hd-kit.description: Optional hardware kit, quoted separately with brand/model

hardware-kit-4-cam-hd-kit.title: Hardware kit — 4-cam HD kit

hardware-kit-8-cam-kit.title: Hardware kit — 8-cam kit
hardware-kit-8-cam-kit.description: Optional hardware kit, quoted separately with brand/model

faqs.question: Can I give my own cameras?
faqs.answer: Yes. Book the labour package only. We check the hardware works before mounting; faulty units have to be replaced by your seller.

faqs.question: Which brand should I pick?
faqs.answer: CP Plus, Hikvision and Dahua are the common brands sold and serviced in Patna. Spare parts and local repair are easy to find for all three.

faqs.question: How many days of recording will I get?
faqs.answer: It depends on hard disk size, number of cameras and resolution. A 1 TB disk with 4 HD cameras usually holds roughly 2–3 weeks; the technician will show the exact figure.

faqs.question: Will I see the cameras on my phone?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the DVR is connected to your Wi-Fi router or internet line. We install the brand app and add the device for you.

faqs.question: Does it work during power cuts?
faqs.answer: Not by itself. Add a small UPS or inverter connection to keep the DVR and cameras running.

faqs.question: Do you do hidden wiring?
faqs.answer: Yes, after a site check. Concealed wiring needs wall chasing and is quoted per metre.

cctv-maintenance.name: CCTV Repair & Maintenance
cctv-maintenance.shortDescription: Technician visit to fix no-video, blurry picture, DVR, cable or mobile-view problems, plus yearly AMC.
cctv-maintenance.fullDescription: When a camera shows a blank screen, the DVR stops recording, or the app goes offline, a technician comes to find the fault. The visit fee covers diagnosis; you approve the repair quote before any work starts, and the visit fee is adjusted in the final bill if you go ahead. Common fixes include loose connectors, failed power supplies, cable faults, hard disk errors and app reconnection. For homes and shops with many cameras, a yearly maintenance plan (AMC) covers scheduled cleaning, health checks and priority visits. Spare parts are charged at printed price.
bullets: Fault check of cameras, DVR/NVR, hard disk, power supply and cables
Repair quote shared before work; visit fee adjusted if you go ahead
Lens cleaning, connector re-crimping and camera angle reset
Mobile app reconnection and password reset (owner proof needed)
AMC option: scheduled service visits and priority call-outs

visit-and-diagnosis.title: Visit & diagnosis
visit-and-diagnosis.description: Technician visit, full system check, written repair quote. Visit fee adjusted in repair bill.

standard-fix-labour.title: Standard fix (labour)
standard-fix-labour.description: One fault: connector/BNC re-crimp, power supply swap, re-angle, HDD format, app reconnect, up to 2 cameras cleaned. Parts extra.

dvr-nvr-and-software-service.title: DVR/NVR & software service
dvr-nvr-and-software-service.description: Firmware update, HDD replace/format, password reset, remote view fix. Parts extra.

yearly-amc-up-to-4-cameras-plus-1-dvr.title: Yearly AMC (up to 4 cameras + 1 DVR)
yearly-amc-up-to-4-cameras-plus-1-dvr.description: 4 quarterly visits: cleaning, health check, recording test, app check; priority call-outs; labour for routine faults included, parts extra. 12 months. Add ₹299 per extra camera.

extraCharges: ₹299 per extra camera on Yearly AMC
excludes: Cameras, DVR/NVR boards, hard disks, adapters/SMPS, connectors and new cable
Cameras higher than 1 floor needing scaffold
Faults caused by lightning/voltage surges are not covered by AMC unless stated

faqs.question: What is the ₹299 visit fee for?
faqs.answer: It covers travel and a full fault check. If you approve the repair, it is adjusted in the final bill.

faqs.question: My cameras show "No Video". What usually causes it?
faqs.answer: Most often a loose connector, a dead power adapter or a damaged cable. Less often the camera itself has failed.

faqs.question: I forgot my DVR password. Can you reset it?
faqs.answer: Yes. We need proof that you own the system (purchase bill or ID at the site address). Some brands need a reset code from the brand.

faqs.question: Do you repair systems installed by someone else?
faqs.answer: Yes. We service CP Plus, Hikvision, Dahua and most other brands, whoever installed them.

faqs.question: What does the AMC cover?
faqs.answer: Four planned visits a year, cleaning, recording and app checks, and labour for routine faults. Parts are charged extra.

wifi-camera-installation.name: Wi-Fi Camera Setup
wifi-camera-installation.shortDescription: Fitting and app setup for a smart Wi-Fi camera like CP Plus ezyKam, Imou, Qubo or Mi.
wifi-camera-installation.fullDescription: Good for a single room, shop counter or main door when you don't need a full DVR system. The technician checks Wi-Fi signal at the spot, mounts the camera on a wall or ceiling (or places it on a shelf), inserts and formats the memory card, connects the camera to your router, and sets up the brand app with alerts and sharing for family members. If the signal is weak, a LAN cable can be run from the router. The camera itself is not included unless you add it.
bullets: Wi-Fi signal check at the chosen spot
Wall or ceiling mounting with neat power cable routing
Memory card insert and format; recording mode set
App setup, motion alerts, family sharing on up to 3 phones
Quick demo of live view, two-way talk and playback

app-setup-only-camera-already-placed.title: App setup only (camera already placed)
app-setup-only-camera-already-placed.description: Connect to Wi-Fi, card format, alerts, sharing

optional-hardware-cp-plus-ezykam-2-4-mp.title: Optional hardware — CP Plus ezyKam 2–4 MP
optional-hardware-cp-plus-ezykam-2-4-mp.description: Optional hardware: CP Plus ezyKam 2–4 MP Wi-Fi camera

optional-hardware-qubo-360-3-4-mp.title: Optional hardware — Qubo 360 3–4 MP
optional-hardware-qubo-360-3-4-mp.description: Optional hardware: Qubo 360 3–4 MP Wi-Fi camera

excludes: Cloud recording subscription (sold by the brand)

faqs.question: Will it record without internet?
faqs.answer: Yes, on the memory card. Internet is needed only to watch on your phone or get alerts.

faqs.question: How long will a 128 GB card record?
faqs.answer: About a week of continuous recording for a typical 1080p camera. Motion-only mode lasts longer.

faqs.question: Does it work in a power cut?
faqs.answer: No, unless the plug point is on inverter or UPS backup. We can fit it near an inverter-backed point.

faqs.question: My Wi-Fi is weak where I want the camera.
faqs.answer: We can run a LAN cable from the router or suggest a Wi-Fi extender. Both are charged extra.

faqs.question: Can my family also see the camera?
faqs.answer: Yes. We add them through the app's share option.

commercial-cctv.name: Office & Shop CCTV
commercial-cctv.shortDescription: CCTV for shops, clinics, godowns and offices — survey, cabling, recorder, and owner phone access.
commercial-cctv.fullDescription: A technician first visits to map entry points, cash counter, stock area and parking, then shares a written quote. Shops often use HD cameras with a DVR; offices and larger sites often prefer IP cameras with an NVR and PoE switch, which give sharper video and need fewer cables. We can add cameras with built-in mics for counters. The owner gets app access on phone and, if needed, viewing on a shop monitor. Labour is priced by camera count; hardware, conduit and extra cable are quoted separately after the survey.
bullets: Free site survey with camera map and written quote (survey fee waived if you book)
HD (DVR) or IP (NVR + PoE) system, CP Plus / Hikvision / Dahua
Cable laying in PVC casing, recorder in a lockable rack if needed
Owner app access plus a local monitor view
Handover demo and staff guidance on playback/export

site-survey-and-quote.title: Site survey & quote
site-survey-and-quote.description: Visit, camera plan, hardware options with prices. Fee adjusted on booking.

shop-4-camera-install-hd-dvr.title: Shop 4-camera install (HD/DVR)
shop-4-camera-install-hd-dvr.description: 4 cameras, up to 80 m cable in casing, DVR + HDD, app + monitor. Labour only — hardware separate.

office-8-camera-install-hd-or-ip.title: Office 8-camera install (HD or IP)
office-8-camera-install-hd-or-ip.description: 8 cameras, up to 160 m cable, DVR/NVR + PoE switch, app on 3 phones. 1 day. Labour only — hardware separate.

12-16-camera-multi-floor.title: 12–16 camera / multi-floor
12-16-camera-multi-floor.description: Custom quote after survey. Labour only — hardware separate.

excludes: All hardware (cameras, recorder, HDD, PoE switch, rack, monitor, UPS)

faqs.question: HD or IP cameras for my shop?
faqs.answer: For up to 8 cameras in one room, HD with a DVR is cheaper and works well. IP is better for sharper video, larger spaces, or future expansion.

faqs.question: Can I hear sound at the counter?
faqs.answer: Yes, with audio cameras (built-in mic). Tell us during the survey so the right recorder is chosen.

faqs.question: Can I watch two branches from one phone?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both recorders can be added to the same brand app.

faqs.question: Will installation disturb business?
faqs.answer: Most shop jobs finish in half a day. We can start before opening time or after closing, if arranged in advance.

tap-faucet-repair.name: Tap & Faucet Repair
tap-faucet-repair.shortDescription: Fix leaking, dripping or loose taps, or fit a new tap or sink mixer you have bought.
tap-faucet-repair.fullDescription: A dripping tap wastes water and raises the motor's running time. Our plumber checks the tap, finds the cause (worn washer, spindle, cartridge or loose body) and repairs it on the spot. If the tap is beyond repair, we fit a new one, either brought by you or bought by us at the shop bill price. We also fit kitchen sink mixers, wall-mixers, extension nozzles and aerators. Price is per tap, labour only. Parts like washers or cartridges are charged at actual cost.
bullets: Diagnosis and repair of dripping or leaking taps
Washer, spindle or cartridge change (part extra)
New tap or sink mixer fitting with thread tape sealing
Leak test after work and area wiped clean

tap-installation-replacement-per-tap.title: Tap installation / replacement (per tap)
tap-installation-replacement-per-tap.description: Remove old tap, fit new one, seal, test

sink-wall-mixer-installation.title: Sink / wall mixer installation
sink-wall-mixer-installation.description: Fit kitchen or basin mixer, connect hoses

tap-combo-any-3-taps-repair-replace.title: Tap combo (any 3 taps repair/replace)
tap-combo-any-3-taps-repair-replace.description: Repair or replacement of any 3 taps

excludes: ₹99 inspection if no work is done

faqs.question: Do I need to buy the tap first?
faqs.answer: No. You can buy it yourself, or the plumber can buy it locally and you pay the shop bill.

faqs.question: My tap still drips after closing tightly. Can it be fixed?
faqs.answer: Usually yes. Most drips come from a worn washer or cartridge, which is a cheap part.

faqs.question: Is the price per tap?
faqs.answer: Yes, labour is per tap. The 3-tap combo is cheaper if several taps need work.

faqs.question: Can you fix a concealed (in-wall) tap body?
faqs.answer: The plumber will inspect and quote. If tiles must be opened, that is quoted separately before starting.

faqs.question: Will water supply be stopped?
faqs.answer: Briefly. The plumber will close the main valve or stop the motor during work.

shower-mixer-repair.name: Shower & Mixer Repair
shower-mixer-repair.shortDescription: Repair or fit showers, hand showers, diverters and bathroom wall mixers for steady hot and cold water.
shower-mixer-repair.fullDescription: Low flow, a stuck diverter or a shower head that leaks at the joint are common problems, often caused by hard water scale. Our plumber cleans or repairs the shower head, fixes leaks at the arm and hose, and repairs or replaces the diverter or mixer cartridge. We also fit new overhead showers, hand showers, shower filters and wall-mounted hot-and-cold mixers. Prices cover labour; any new shower, hose or cartridge is billed at cost or supplied by you.
bullets: Shower head descaling and leak fixing
Diverter / mixer cartridge repair or change (part extra)
New overhead shower, hand shower or shower filter fitting
Wall mixer installation on existing hot and cold points
Flow and leak check after work

shower-repair.title: Shower repair
shower-repair.description: Clean/descale head, fix arm or hose leak

shower-installation-overhead-or-hand-sho.title: Shower installation (overhead or hand shower)
shower-installation-overhead-or-hand-sho.description: Installation of an overhead or hand shower

shower-mixer-diverter-installation-or-ca.title: Shower mixer / diverter installation or cartridge change
shower-mixer-diverter-installation-or-ca.description: Shower mixer or diverter installation, or cartridge change

excludes: New concealed hot/cold lines or tile cutting

faqs.question: Why is my shower flow weak?
faqs.answer: Usually scale blocks the nozzles or the filter. Cleaning often fixes it; low tank height can also reduce pressure.

faqs.question: Can you fit a mixer if I only have a cold line?
faqs.answer: A hot-and-cold mixer needs both lines. Adding a hot line is a new-fitting job and is quoted separately.

faqs.question: Do you repair branded mixers like Jaquar or Cera?
faqs.answer: Yes, labour is the same. Brand cartridges must match the model, so bring the old one or the model number.

faqs.question: Does a shower filter help with Patna's hard water?
faqs.answer: It reduces chlorine and some sediment. Filter cartridges need regular change; follow the maker's guidance.

faqs.question: Is geyser repair included?
faqs.answer: No. Only the water connection to the geyser is covered under plumbing.

toilet-repair-installation.name: Toilet Repair & Installation
toilet-repair-installation.shortDescription: Fix running flush tanks, leaks and seats, or install western and Indian toilets with proper sealing.
toilet-repair-installation.fullDescription: A running flush wastes hundreds of litres a day, and a loose commode can leak at the base. Our plumber repairs flush tanks (inner fittings, push button, handle), replaces external PVC cisterns, fits seat covers and jet sprays, and repairs or installs Indian (squat) and western (floor or wall-mounted) toilets. Installation includes fixing, connecting the soil outlet and water inlet, and sealing. Toilet pots, cisterns, seats and fittings are extra; you can supply them or we buy at shop rate.
bullets: Flush tank repair: inlet valve, outlet/siphon, button or handle
External PVC flush tank replacement
Seat cover and jet spray (health faucet) fitting
Western and Indian WC repair, re-fixing or new installation
Leak test of inlet, outlet and base after work

seat-cover-jet-spray-fitting.description: Seat cover or jet spray fitting

flush-tank-repair-internal-parts-or-exte.description: Flush tank repair of internal parts or external PVC tank

external-flush-tank-replacement.title: External flush tank replacement
external-flush-tank-replacement.description: Remove old, fit new cistern, connect

wc-repair-or-installation-indian-or-west.title: WC repair or installation (Indian or western floor-mounted)
wc-repair-or-installation-indian-or-west.description: WC repair or installation (Indian or western floor-mounted)

faqs.question: My flush keeps running. Is that a repair or replacement?
faqs.answer: Mostly a repair. A worn inlet valve or outlet seal is replaced; the whole cistern is changed only if cracked.

faqs.question: Can you convert an Indian toilet to western?
faqs.answer: Yes, but floor breaking and re-levelling are needed. The plumber inspects and gives a fixed quote first.

faqs.question: Do you install wall-mounted (wall-hung) toilets?
faqs.answer: Repair yes. New wall-hung units need a concealed frame, so they are quoted after inspection.

faqs.question: How long before I can use the toilet after installation?
faqs.answer: Usually after the cement or sealant sets, often a few hours. The plumber will tell you the exact time.

faqs.question: Is a seat cover included in installation?
faqs.answer: Fitting it is included if you have one; the seat itself is extra.

water-tank-installation-cleaning.name: Water Tank Installation & Cleaning
water-tank-installation-cleaning.shortDescription: Install a new rooftop plastic tank (Sintex-type) with inlet, outlet and overflow, or get tanks cleaned.
water-tank-installation-cleaning.fullDescription: We fit new overhead plastic water tanks on your existing roof platform or stand, connect the inlet from the motor, the outlet to the house line, the overflow and a drain valve, and check for leaks. We also replace old tanks, fix leaking tank connections and float valves, and clean overhead, loft and underground tanks. Cleaning includes draining, scrubbing sludge and rinsing. The tank, pipes, valves and fittings are extra. Lifting a tank to upper floors may need extra helpers, which we confirm before booking.
bullets: New overhead tank fitting on existing platform/stand
Inlet, outlet, overflow and drain valve connections
Old tank removal and replacement
Overhead, loft and underground tank cleaning
Leak and flow check after work
excludes: Pipes, ball valve, float valve, unions
Building/repairing the tank platform or stand (mason work)

faqs.question: Do you supply the tank?
faqs.answer: You can buy it from a dealer or brand site. We can arrange one at the bill price if you prefer.

faqs.question: Who lifts the tank to the roof?
faqs.answer: Our team handles it for normal houses. For 3+ floors or no stairs access, extra helpers are quoted before booking.

faqs.question: Do I need a platform?
faqs.answer: Yes. A full 1,000 L tank weighs over a tonne. It must sit on a flat, strong platform or stand.

faqs.question: How often should tanks be cleaned?
faqs.answer: Many households clean every 3–6 months; more often if water looks muddy or smells.

faqs.question: Will I be without water during cleaning?
faqs.answer: For an hour or two. Store some water in buckets beforehand.

full-home-plumbing.name: Full Home Plumbing (New Fitting / Re-piping)
full-home-plumbing.shortDescription: New pipe fitting or re-piping for bathrooms and kitchens, priced per bathroom or kitchen after a site visit.
full-home-plumbing.fullDescription: For new houses, renovations or old GI lines that leak, our plumbing team lays new CPVC (hot and cold) and UPVC (waste and soil) lines. The job is counted in "points": each place water arrives or drains. A normal bathroom has about 8–12 points. We survey the site, count points, agree concealed or exposed pipework, and give a written quote. Work ends with a pressure test before walls are closed. Labour prices below exclude pipes, fittings, wall chasing repair and sanitaryware.
bullets: Site survey and point-wise written quote
CPVC supply lines and UPVC drainage lines
Concealed or exposed pipework as agreed
Pressure test before walls/tiles are closed
Fixing of taps, WC, basin and shower after tiling (if booked)

site-survey-and-quote.title: Site survey & quote
site-survey-and-quote.description: Point count, material list. ₹199 adjusted in final bill.

bathroom-plumbing-exposed.title: Bathroom plumbing, exposed
bathroom-plumbing-exposed.description: Labour only, up to 10 points. 1–2 days.

bathroom-plumbing-concealed.title: Bathroom plumbing, concealed
bathroom-plumbing-concealed.description: Labour only, up to 10 points. 2–3 days.

kitchen-plumbing.title: Kitchen plumbing
kitchen-plumbing.description: Sink, RO, washing machine; up to 5 points. 1 day. Extra point ₹449.

faqs.question: What is a "point"?
faqs.answer: Each place water comes out or drains, e.g. a basin with hot and cold is two supply points plus one drain.

faqs.question: Concealed or exposed — which is better?
faqs.answer: Concealed looks neater but costs more and needs tile breaking for future repairs. Exposed is cheaper and easy to reach.

faqs.question: Is material included?
faqs.answer: No. We give a material list; you buy it or we buy at bill price. Branded CPVC is advised.

faqs.question: Do you test before tiling?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lines are pressure-tested before walls are closed, so leaks are caught early.

faqs.question: Can you replace old GI pipes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Old GI supply lines can be swapped for CPVC; the survey decides how much wall must be opened.

faqs.question: How is payment made?
faqs.answer: Usually an advance after the quote and the balance on completion, online or cash.

home-wiring-rewiring.name: Full Home Wiring
home-wiring-rewiring.shortDescription: New points, extra wiring runs or full house rewiring, open (casing) or concealed in the wall.
home-wiring-rewiring.fullDescription: Need a new plug point, a fresh line to the kitchen, or a full rewiring of an old house? Our electrician first checks the load, existing wires and the main board, then gives you a written quote before any work begins. Small jobs like adding wire in PVC casing are charged per 5 metres. New points are charged per point. Full home rewiring is quoted per point or per square foot after a site visit. You can buy the material yourself or ask us to bring ISI-marked wire, conduit and switches at bill price.
bullets: Site visit and written quote before work starts
Open wiring in PVC casing or concealed wiring in wall chase
Per-point pricing for new light, fan and socket points
Load check so AC/geyser lines get the right wire size
Old wire removed and connections tested after the job

wiring-visit-and-estimate.title: Wiring visit & estimate
wiring-visit-and-estimate.description: Check of wiring, DB/MCB and load; written quote for rewiring. ₹99 adjusted in final bill.

open-wiring-in-pvc-casing-per-5-m.title: Open wiring in PVC casing (per 5 m)
open-wiring-in-pvc-casing-per-5-m.description: Run new wire inside surface casing along wall, connect to existing point; labour only

concealed-new-point-per-point-labour-onl.description: Wall chasing, conduit laying, wire pulling, box fixing, switch connection for one light/fan/6A socket point; plaster patch not included. Takes 60–90 min.

concealed-new-point-per-point-labour-onl.title: Concealed new point (per point, labour only) — 16A/AC/geyser power point
concealed-new-point-per-point-labour-onl.description: Wall chasing, conduit laying, wire pulling, box fixing, switch connection for one 16A/AC/geyser power point; plaster patch not included. Takes 60–90 min.

full-home-rewiring-labour-only.title: Full home rewiring (labour only)
full-home-rewiring-labour-only.description: Remove old wiring, new concealed/open wiring for all points, DB connection and testing; quoted after visit. Takes 2–5 days. Typical 2BHK 50–75 points ≈ ₹11,000–16,500 labour.

excludes: Wire, conduit, casing, switches, boxes, MCB/DB, RCCB (customer buys or we supply at bill price)
Wall plaster patch and paint after chasing

faqs.question: What is the difference between open and concealed wiring?
faqs.answer: Open wiring runs on the wall inside a PVC casing. It is quicker and cheaper. Concealed wiring runs inside a groove cut into the wall, so it is neater but needs plaster repair.

faqs.question: Do I need to buy the wire myself?
faqs.answer: Your choice. You can buy it, or we bring ISI-marked copper wire and branded switches and add the shop bill to your invoice.

faqs.question: How is a full rewiring priced?
faqs.answer: After a site visit we count the points (lights, fans, sockets, AC lines) and quote per point. You see the full amount before work starts.

faqs.question: How long does rewiring a 2BHK take?
faqs.answer: Usually 2 to 5 working days, depending on concealed vs open wiring, wall type and how many points need changing.

faqs.question: Will you repair the wall after chasing?
faqs.answer: We fill the groove with basic patch. Final plaster finish and painting are extra or can be booked separately.

faqs.question: Is there a visit charge?
faqs.answer: ₹99 for inspection and quote. It is adjusted in your bill if you book the work.

fan-light-installation.name: Fan Installation & Lights
fan-light-installation.shortDescription: Fit or replace ceiling, exhaust and wall fans, tube lights, ceiling lights, chandeliers and switchboards.
fan-light-installation.fullDescription: Bought a new fan or light, or need an old one swapped? Our electrician comes with tools, fits it on your existing point, and tests it before leaving. We also replace damaged switches and full switchboards. Prices are per unit on existing wiring. If a new point or extra wire is needed, you get the extra cost before we start.

Old fan or light taken down at no extra cost when replacing
Regulator, switch and socket swap on the same visit
Chandeliers fitted with proper support for weight
Electrician brings tools; you supply the fan/light

faqs.question: Do you bring the fan or light?
faqs.answer: No. You buy the item; we install it. We can pick up small parts like a capacitor or switch and add the shop bill.

faqs.question: My ceiling has no fan hook. Can you still fit a fan?
faqs.answer: Yes, but a new hook or clamp costs extra. The electrician will tell you the price before drilling.

faqs.question: Is removing the old fan charged?
faqs.answer: When you are replacing it, taking down the old fan is included. Removal only is charged as a separate small job.

faqs.question: How heavy a chandelier can you fit?
faqs.answer: Most home chandeliers. Heavy pieces need a strong ceiling anchor; we check the ceiling and quote before fitting.

faqs.question: My new BLDC fan has a remote. Will you set it up?
faqs.answer: Yes. We pair the remote and test all speeds and light modes before leaving.

Our electrician installs a new inverter or home UPS with its battery, connects it to the lines you want on backup, and checks charging and changeover. We also move or remove old units, replace batteries, top up distilled water, clean terminals and find faults when backup time drops or the unit beeps. You buy the inverter and battery, or we help you choose. Repairs are quoted after a check-up, before any part is changed.

Backup wiring to selected lights, fans and sockets
Battery swap with terminal cleaning and polarity check

Fault check with a quote before any repair

battery-replacement.title: Battery replacement

faqs.question: Do I need separate wiring for an inverter?
faqs.answer: If your house has no backup line, yes. We can wire selected lights and fans to the inverter, or connect the whole house through a changeover if load allows.

faqs.question: How often should the battery be serviced?
faqs.answer: Check the water level regularly, more often in summer, and keep terminals clean. Top up only with distilled water. Our technician can show you how.

faqs.question: My backup time has dropped. Is the battery dead?
faqs.answer: Not always. Low water, loose terminals or wrong charging settings can cause it. A check-up tells you whether to service or replace.

faqs.question: Do you sell inverters or batteries?
faqs.answer: You buy them from any shop or brand. We install and connect them. We can suggest the right capacity for your load.

faqs.question: Will brand warranty stay valid?
faqs.answer: Brand warranty follows the brand's own terms. Keep your purchase bill and check whether the brand asks for its own installer before booking us.

door-installation-repair.name: Door Installation & Repair
door-installation-repair.shortDescription: Fix sticking, sagging or broken wooden doors, and fit new doors, locks, hinges and stoppers.
door-installation-repair.fullDescription: A carpenter visits your home to fix doors that rub, sag, won't latch or have loose frames. We plane and realign the shutter, change worn hinges, repair or replace locks and latches, and fit tower bolts, handles, stoppers and mesh. For new doors, we hang the shutter on your existing frame or fit a new frame. You buy the door and hardware, or we bring them at market price with the bill shown before fitting. Labour and material are listed separately so you know what you pay for.
bullets: Door planing and alignment for doors that stick or don't close
Hinge, lock, latch, handle and tower-bolt repair or replacement
New door shutter or frame fitting
Mosquito mesh and door stopper installation
Separate bill for labour and parts

lock-latch-hinge-replace-hinge-set.title: Lock / latch / hinge replace — Hinge set

faqs.question: Do I need to buy the lock or hinges?
faqs.answer: You can buy them yourself, or the carpenter can bring them. Parts are billed at shop price with the bill shown before fitting.

faqs.question: My door sticks only in monsoon. Can you fix it?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wood swells with moisture. The carpenter planes the edge and realigns hinges so it closes in all seasons.

faqs.question: Do you fit flush doors and PVC doors?
faqs.answer: Yes, both. PVC and WPC doors are lighter and usually take less time.

faqs.question: Is there a visit charge?
faqs.answer: ₹99 if you only want an inspection. It is adjusted in the bill if you book the work.

faqs.question: Do you polish the new door?
faqs.answer: Polishing is a separate service, charged per sq ft.

window-repair-fitting.name: Window Repair & Fitting
window-repair-fitting.shortDescription: Repair jammed wooden windows, change stays and handles, fit mesh, curtain rods and window AC frames.
window-repair-fitting.fullDescription: Wooden windows swell, drop on their hinges and stop closing, especially after the rains. Our carpenter realigns shutters, replaces stays, aldrops, handles and hinges, and fixes loose frames. We also fit mosquito mesh, curtain rods and wooden frames for window ACs. Glass cutting and aluminium/UPVC sliding windows need a specialist and are quoted separately. You pay labour per item; any parts are billed separately at shop price.
bullets: Jammed or misaligned window repair
Hinge, stay, handle and aldrop replacement
Mosquito mesh and curtain rod fitting
Window AC frame fitting or removal

faqs.question: Do you replace broken glass?
faqs.answer: Glass cutting is quoted separately after the visit. The carpenter can remove and refit the panel.

faqs.question: Can you fix aluminium sliding windows?
faqs.answer: Roller and lock changes are possible. Full track or frame work needs a fabricator and is quoted separately.

faqs.question: Can I give my own curtain rods?
faqs.answer: Yes. We fit customer-supplied rods and brackets at the same labour charge.

faqs.question: What wall types can you drill?
faqs.answer: Brick, concrete and wood. Tiled or very hard walls may need special bits at extra cost.

wardrobe-cabinet-work.name: Wardrobe & Cabinet Work
wardrobe-cabinet-work.shortDescription: Repair hinges, channels and locks, or get a new wardrobe built at a per sq ft rate.
wardrobe-cabinet-work.fullDescription: For existing wardrobes and cabinets, we fix sagging shutters, change auto hinges and drawer channels, replace locks and handles, and fit extra shelves. For new built-in wardrobes, the carpenter measures on site and gives a written quote per sq ft. You can choose labour-only (you buy plywood, laminate and hardware) or a full job with material. The quote lists ply grade, laminate, hinge and channel brand so you can compare.
bullets: Hinge (normal or soft-close) and drawer channel replacement
Cupboard and drawer lock repair or change
Shelf fitting and shutter alignment
New wardrobe: labour-only or with material, quoted per sq ft
Written quote that splits labour and material

faqs.question: How is the wardrobe area measured?
faqs.answer: Width × height of the front face, in sq ft. A 6 ft wide, 7 ft high wardrobe is 42 sq ft. Lofts are added separately.

faqs.question: Labour-only or with material — which is better?
faqs.answer: Labour-only lets you pick every brand yourself. With material is simpler. Either way, the quote shows both lines.

faqs.question: Do sliding wardrobes cost more?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tracks and heavier hardware add cost.

faqs.question: Which plywood suits Patna's humidity?
faqs.answer: BWR or BWP plywood holds up better to damp than MDF or particle board.

faqs.question: How long does a new wardrobe take?
faqs.answer: Usually 5–10 working days on site for a standard bedroom wardrobe, depending on size and finish.

faqs.question: How is kitchen cost worked out?
faqs.answer: Per sq ft of cabinet front area, or per running foot of counter. We quote per sq ft and show the calculation.

faqs.question: Is the countertop included?
faqs.answer: No. Granite or quartz is quoted separately by the stone supplier.

faqs.question: Why BWP plywood under the sink?
faqs.answer: It resists water far better. MDF and particle board swell quickly when wet.

faqs.question: Can you only replace swollen sink cabinets?
faqs.answer: Yes. We remove the damaged base and rebuild it, quoted after the visit.

faqs.question: Do you fit baskets I bought online?
faqs.answer: Yes, at labour-only rates, if sizes match the cabinet.

custom-furniture.shortDescription: Beds, TV units, study tables and shelves made to your size at home, priced per sq ft.

faqs.question: Should I buy material myself?
faqs.answer: You can, for labour-only pricing. Otherwise we supply and show bills for ply and hardware.

faqs.question: Is day hire or per sq ft better?
faqs.answer: Per sq ft for new furniture. Day hire suits a list of small repairs or fittings.

faqs.question: Do you make solid sheesham furniture?
faqs.answer: Possible, quoted per item after the visit. Solid wood costs much more than ply.

mens-haircut.name: Haircut & Styling
mens-haircut.shortDescription: A barber comes to your home for a men's or boys' haircut, with clean tools and cleanup after.
mens-haircut.fullDescription: Skip the queue at the salon. A trained barber comes to your home with his own kit, a cape and a sheet for the floor. He asks what style you want, looks at your face shape and hair type, then cuts with scissors and clippers. He finishes with a neck trim, light styling and a quick sweep of the area. Boys aged 2+ can be booked too. Add a beard trim or a head massage in the same visit to save money.

Style chat before the cut (fade, crop, short back & sides, etc.)
Neck and sideburn cleanup and basic styling at the end
Hair swept up and area left clean
Freshly cleaned tools for every customer

faqs.question: Do I need to arrange anything?
faqs.answer: Just a chair near a window or good light, and a little space. The barber brings the cape, floor sheet and all tools.

faqs.question: Will hair be left on the floor?
faqs.answer: No. The barber lays a sheet and sweeps up when done.

faqs.question: Can I book for my son too?
faqs.answer: Yes, kids aged 2 and above can be booked. Add one booking per person.

faqs.question: Are tools clean?
faqs.answer: Tools are cleaned and sanitised before each customer. Razors and neck strips are single-use.

faqs.question: Can I ask for a fade or a specific style?
faqs.answer: Yes. Show a photo if you have one. Very complex designs may take extra time.

faqs.question: Is hair wash included?
faqs.answer: No. A wash needs a bathroom. You can wash before the visit, slightly damp hair is fine.

beard-grooming.name: Beard Trimming & Shave
beard-grooming.shortDescription: Beard shaping, trimming or a clean shave at home, done with a fresh single-use blade.
beard-grooming.fullDescription: Get your beard shaped by a trained barber without leaving home. He trims the length, sets clean lines on the cheeks and neck, and shapes the moustache to suit your face. If you want it all off, choose a clean shave with foam and a new blade, followed by an after-shave. Beard colour is available for men who want to cover grey. It pairs well with a haircut in the same visit.
bullets: Beard length set with trimmer, edges lined with a fresh blade
Moustache shaping included
Clean shave option with foam and after-shave
New single-use blade for every customer
Optional beard colour to cover grey

faqs.question: Can I choose a beard style?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell the barber the look you want, like stubble, short boxed or full. A reference photo helps.

faqs.question: Is the blade new?
faqs.answer: Yes, a new single-use blade is opened in front of you.

faqs.question: Can I book only a beard trim?
faqs.answer: Yes, but adding it to a haircut works out cheaper.

faqs.question: I have sensitive skin. Any tips?
faqs.answer: Tell the barber before starting. He can use a trimmer only and skip the blade on sensitive areas.

faqs.question: Does beard colour stain skin?
faqs.answer: Some stain on skin is possible but fades in a day or two. The barber wipes excess right away.

mens-facial.name: Facial & Cleanup (Men)
mens-facial.shortDescription: Cleanup or full facial for men at home, to clear oil, dirt and dead skin and freshen dull skin.
mens-facial.fullDescription: Men's skin gets oily and dull from sun, dust and shaving. Our groomer brings everything needed for a cleanup or a full facial at your home. A cleanup is quick: cleanse, scrub, steam, blackhead removal and a face pack. A full facial adds a longer massage and a serum or mask for brightening or hydration. Tell the groomer your skin type (oily, dry, acne-prone) so the right products are used. Good before a wedding, interview or event.
bullets: Skin check and product choice for oily, dry or normal skin
Cleanse, scrub, steam and blackhead removal
Face massage and pack (longer massage in full facial)
Branded, sealed products; fresh towels and disposables
Groomer leaves the space clean

blackhead-removal-nose-chin-focus.title: Blackhead removal (nose/chin focus)
blackhead-removal-nose-chin-focus.description: Blackhead removal focused on nose and chin

faqs.question: Cleanup or facial — which do I need?
faqs.answer: Cleanup for regular care every 3–4 weeks. Full facial when skin looks very dull or before an event.

faqs.question: Which brands are used?
faqs.answer: Branded professional products in sealed packs. The groomer shows the pack before starting.

faqs.question: I have acne. Can I book?
faqs.answer: Tell us when booking. Mild acne is fine with a gentle cleanup. For active, painful acne, see a dermatologist first.

faqs.question: When should I shave?
faqs.answer: Shave a day before, not the same day, to avoid stinging.

faqs.question: How soon can I go in the sun?
faqs.answer: Try to stay out of strong sun for a few hours and use sunscreen.

faqs.question: Do I need to arrange anything?
faqs.answer: A chair or bed to lie back on, a plug point for the steamer and a bucket of water.

mens-face-bleach-at-home.name: Face Bleach
mens-face-bleach-at-home.shortDescription: Mild face and neck bleach at home to lighten facial hair and even out dull skin tone.
mens-face-bleach-at-home.fullDescription: Bleach lightens fine facial hair and makes uneven, tanned skin look more even for a few weeks. The groomer does a patch test on your inner arm first, then cleans your face, mixes a mild bleach cream (oxy or protein type) and applies it on face and neck. It stays on for about 10–15 minutes, then is wiped off and a soothing cream is applied. It is quick and works well before an event. Not for broken, sunburnt or very sensitive skin.
bullets: Patch test before applying
Face and neck covered
Mild oxy or protein bleach, sealed pack
Soothing cream after removal
Done in about 25 minutes

faqs.question: Does bleach make skin fair?
faqs.answer: No. It lightens fine hair and makes tan look less visible. Effect is temporary.

faqs.question: Will it sting?
faqs.answer: A light tingling is normal. If it burns, tell the groomer and it is removed at once.

faqs.question: Who should avoid it?
faqs.answer: Anyone with cuts, acne flare, sunburn, eczema or recent shaving on the face.

faqs.question: How often?
faqs.answer: Not more than once a month.

faqs.question: Is a patch test done?
faqs.answer: Yes, always, on the inner arm before applying on the face.

mens-detan-at-home.name: De-Tan Treatment
mens-detan-at-home.shortDescription: A de-tan pack for face, neck or hands to reduce sun tan and dullness, done at home.
mens-detan-at-home.fullDescription: Patna summers and bike rides leave a tan line on the face, neck and arms. A de-tan pack helps lift that tan and brightens dull skin. The groomer cleans the skin, applies a de-tan pack (often with ingredients like yoghurt, papaya or lemon extracts), leaves it on for about 10–15 minutes, then removes it and applies a moisturiser. Unlike bleach, it does not lighten hair. Results show after the first session and improve with repeat sessions.
bullets: Cleansing before the pack
De-tan pack on face & neck or hands
Moisturiser after removal
Sealed, branded products
Can be added to a haircut or cleanup visit

face-plus-hands-de-tan-combo.title: Face + hands de-tan combo
face-plus-hands-de-tan-combo.description: De-tan pack on face and hands

faqs.question: De-tan or bleach — which is better?
faqs.answer: De-tan works on sun tan without lightening hair. Bleach lightens facial hair too. For tan alone, choose de-tan.

faqs.question: How many sessions?
faqs.answer: You see a change in one session. Heavy tan may need 2–3 sessions a couple of weeks apart.

faqs.question: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, but tell the groomer. Avoid it on cuts or sunburn.

faqs.question: How do I keep the tan away?
faqs.answer: Use sunscreen daily and cover up on two-wheelers.

mens-face-scrub-at-home.name: Face Scrub
mens-face-scrub-at-home.shortDescription: A quick face and neck scrub at home to clear dead skin, oil and dust. Best as an add-on.
mens-face-scrub-at-home.fullDescription: A scrub removes dead skin and surface dirt so your face feels smoother and shaves better. The groomer cleans your face, massages a gentle scrub over face and neck for a few minutes, wipes it off with warm towels and applies a light moisturiser. It takes about 15 minutes, so it works best as an add-on to a haircut or beard trim. For deeper results, choose a cleanup, which includes a scrub plus steam and a pack.

Gentle scrub massage on face and neck
Warm towel wipe-off and moisturiser
About 15 minutes

faqs.question: How often should I scrub?
faqs.answer: Once or twice a week at most. Over-scrubbing can irritate skin.

faqs.question: Can I book only a scrub?
faqs.answer: It is best as an add-on with a haircut or beard trim, since the visit is short.

faqs.question: I have acne. Is it okay?
faqs.answer: Avoid scrubbing over active pimples. The groomer will skip those areas.

faqs.question: Scrub or cleanup?
faqs.answer: A scrub is quick surface care. A cleanup adds steam, blackhead removal and a pack.

hair-styling-care.name: Haircut & Styling
hair-styling-care.shortDescription: Haircut, trim or blow-dry for women at home, by a trained stylist with clean tools.
hair-styling-care.fullDescription: A stylist comes to your home with scissors, comb, dryer and straightener. First you talk about the look you want. The stylist checks your hair length and texture, then does the cut or trim. If you book styling, your hair is blow-dried straight, given soft in/out curls, or ironed for a smooth finish. Your hair should be washed and dry before the visit, unless you book a wash. The stylist cleans up loose hair afterwards. This works for a monthly trim, a new cut, or getting ready for a function.

Split ends removed with very little length lost (trim)
Blow-dry straight, in-curl/out-curl, or straightener finish
Stylist brings sanitised tools and cleans up cut hair afterwards

haircut-for-women.title: Haircut for women

excludes: Styling products the customer wants to keep

faqs.question: Should I wash my hair before the stylist comes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Please have clean, fully dry hair, unless you add a hair wash to the booking.

faqs.question: Can I get a cut for my daughter too?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add a girls' haircut to the same booking so one stylist does both haircuts in one visit.

faqs.question: What does the stylist bring?
faqs.answer: Scissors, combs, clips, a cape, a dryer and a straightener or curling tong. You only need a chair near a power socket and a mirror.

faqs.question: How long will styling last?
faqs.answer: A blow-dry or ironing usually lasts until your next wash. Humidity and sweat can shorten it.

faqs.question: Can I show a reference photo?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share it at the start. The stylist will tell you honestly if your hair length or texture suits that style.

hair-smoothening-keratin.name: Hair Straightening — Smoothening / Keratin / Botox
hair-smoothening-keratin.shortDescription: Keratin, smoothening or hair botox at home for frizz-free, manageable hair. Price depends on hair length.
hair-smoothening-keratin.fullDescription: These treatments reduce frizz and make hair easier to manage for weeks or months. Keratin and botox coat the hair and seal it with heat, so hair looks smoother and shinier without becoming poker-straight. Smoothening uses a stronger chemical step, so the hair becomes straighter and the change lasts longer. The stylist washes your hair, applies the product section by section, blow-dries it and then irons it in fine sections to seal the treatment. It takes 3–4 hours, so plan a free afternoon. Aftercare matters: use a sulphate-free shampoo and conditioner.
bullets: Hair-length check and strand test before starting
Wash, product application, blow-dry and ironing in fine sections to seal it in
Branded professional products (brand named on the booking)
Aftercare advice: sulphate-free shampoo and when to first wash

faqs.question: Keratin or smoothening, which should I pick?
faqs.answer: Keratin is gentler and keeps some natural movement. Smoothening makes hair straighter and lasts longer, but uses a stronger chemical. The stylist will suggest one after looking at your hair.

faqs.question: How long does it last?
faqs.answer: It depends on the product, your hair, and how often you wash it. Ask the stylist for the product's expected life. Sulphate-free shampoo helps it last longer.

faqs.question: When can I wash my hair?
faqs.answer: Follow what the stylist tells you for the product used. Usually you wait a few days. After that, use only sulphate-free shampoo.

faqs.question: Is it safe on coloured hair?
faqs.answer: Usually yes. Tell the stylist about any colour, henna or past chemical treatment so they can do a strand test first.

faqs.question: Why is the final price different from the listed price?
faqs.answer: Listed prices are for the length shown. Longer or thicker hair needs more product. The stylist confirms the price before starting.

hair-colour-at-home.name: Hair Coloring — Root Touch-up / Global / Highlights
hair-colour-at-home.shortDescription: Root touch-up, full hair colour or highlights at home with L'Oréal professional shades, or your own colour.
hair-colour-at-home.fullDescription: A trained stylist colours your hair at home. They help you pick a shade, check your scalp, and do a patch test if this is your first time with the brand. A root touch-up covers grey regrowth near the scalp. Global colour covers all your hair in one shade. Highlights or balayage add lighter strands for a softer look. The stylist uses L'Oréal Majirel or the ammonia-free Inoa range, applies it section by section, rinses, and leaves your hair conditioned. If you already have a colour you like, you can book application only.

Rinse and conditioning afterwards; stylist protects floor and furniture

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: L'Oréal, up to shoulder length (120–150 min)

faqs.question: Majirel or Inoa, what's the difference?
faqs.answer: Both are L'Oréal Professionnel colours. Inoa has no ammonia, so it smells milder and feels gentler, and it costs a little more. Majirel gives strong grey coverage.

faqs.question: Do I need a patch test?
faqs.answer: We recommend one if you are new to a brand or have a sensitive scalp. Book it a day or two before the colour visit.

faqs.question: Can I use my own colour?
faqs.answer: Yes. Book "application only". The stylist will check that the pack is sealed and in date before using it.

faqs.question: Will it stain my floor or towels?
faqs.answer: The stylist covers the area and your shoulders. Wear an old T-shirt, as colour can stain fabric.

faqs.question: How often should I do a root touch-up?
faqs.answer: Most people need one every 4–6 weeks, depending on how fast their hair grows and how much grey shows.

facial-cleanup.name: Facial & Cleanup
facial-cleanup.shortDescription: Cleanup or facial at home with Lotus, O3+ or similar professional products, chosen for your skin type.
facial-cleanup.fullDescription: A beautician comes to your home and asks about your skin first: oily, dry, sensitive, tanned or dull. A cleanup is a short routine: cleansing, scrubbing, steam, blackhead removal and a mask. A facial adds a longer massage, a serum and a treatment mask, so it gives a deeper glow. Products come from professional ranges such as Lotus Professional and O3+, opened in front of you. Disposable sheets and wipes are used. Tell the beautician about any acne, allergy or skin medicine before starting.

Cleanse, scrub, steam, blackhead removal, massage and mask (facial)
Professional brands such as Lotus Professional and O3+, plus fruit or herbal options

faqs.question: Cleanup or facial, which do I need?
faqs.answer: A cleanup is a quick monthly refresh. A facial takes longer, with more massage and a treatment mask. Pick a facial before an event or if your skin looks dull.

faqs.question: Can I get bleach with my facial?
faqs.answer: Only with some facials. Brightening facials should not be combined with bleach. Your beautician will tell you what is safe for the facial you book.

faqs.question: Which brands do you use?
faqs.answer: Professional ranges such as O3+ and Lotus Professional. The product name is on your booking, and sealed packs are opened in front of you.

faqs.question: I have acne or sensitive skin. Can I book?
faqs.answer: Tell us when you book. Some brightening facials are not advised for sensitive or acne-prone skin. Choose a gentle cleanup instead.

faqs.question: What should I do afterwards?
faqs.answer: Avoid makeup and strong sun for the rest of the day, and use sunscreen. Don't scrub your face for a couple of days.

face-bleach-at-home.name: Face Bleach
face-bleach-at-home.shortDescription: Gentle face and neck bleach at home to lighten fine facial hair and even out skin tone.
face-bleach-at-home.fullDescription: Bleach lightens fine facial hair so it blends in with your skin, and makes your skin tone look more even. The beautician cleans your face, does a quick patch test if you are new to the product, and mixes a small fresh batch. It is spread on the face and neck, left on for a few minutes, then wiped off and cooled with a soothing pack. We use face-safe bleach creams such as Oxylife or O3+. Pair it with threading or a cleanup in the same visit.

Freshly mixed face-safe bleach (e.g. Oxylife, O3+)

faqs.question: Does bleach remove hair?
faqs.answer: No. It lightens the colour of fine hair so it is less visible. Use threading or waxing to remove hair.

faqs.question: Will it sting?
faqs.answer: Mild tingling is normal. If it burns, tell the beautician right away. They will wipe it off.

faqs.question: Can I bleach after waxing or a facial?
faqs.answer: Avoid bleach on freshly waxed skin. Some brightening facials should not be followed by bleach. Your beautician will check what you booked.

faqs.question: How often can I bleach?
faqs.answer: About once every 3–4 weeks is common. Give your skin time to recover between sessions.

detan-at-home.shortDescription: De-tan pack for the face, neck or arms at home to reduce sun tan and dullness.

The beautician cleans the area, applies the de-tan pack, lets it work for a few minutes, then removes it and finishes with a soothing mask. It does not use bleach, so it suits people who want to avoid bleach. For deeper results, choose the anti-tan cleanup, which adds steam, scrub and a mask.

faqs.question: Is de-tan the same as bleach?
faqs.answer: No. De-tan removes tanned dead skin. Bleach lightens facial hair. De-tan suits people who want to avoid bleach.

faqs.question: Will one session remove all my tan?
faqs.answer: It usually makes skin look brighter right away. Heavy tan may need a few sessions plus daily sunscreen.

faqs.question: Can I do de-tan with waxing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many people book de-tan on arms after waxing. The beautician will skip any irritated area.

faqs.question: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Tell us when you book. The beautician will do a patch test and may pick a milder pack.

Threading uses no chemicals, so it suits sensitive skin and gives sharp brow lines. Fresh thread is used for every customer. Afterwards, a soothing gel or toner calms any redness. Threading is quick and low-cost, so it is usually added to a facial, waxing or haircut visit.

faqs.question: Can I book only eyebrows?
faqs.answer: Threading is usually added to another service. A minimum booking value may apply for a home visit.

faqs.question: Threading or waxing for brows?
faqs.answer: Threading gives more control over shape and uses no chemicals, so it is often better for sensitive skin.

faqs.question: Will my skin turn red?
faqs.answer: Slight redness is normal and usually fades within an hour. Avoid makeup on the area for a few hours.

faqs.question: How often should I thread?
faqs.answer: Most people go every 2–4 weeks, depending on how fast their hair grows.

full-body-waxing.name: Full Body Waxing

Bikini and bikini line are not part of this package and can be added. Let hair grow 3–5 weeks first and do not shave in between. Plan about 90 minutes and keep a fan or AC running in the room.

faqs.question: How long should my hair be?
faqs.answer: About 3–5 weeks of growth works best. Very short hair is harder to pull and hurts more. Do not trim or shave before the visit.

faqs.question: Rica or honey — which should I choose?
faqs.answer: Honey suits most skin and costs less. Rica is gentler and better for sensitive or dry skin, so it costs more.

faqs.question: Is bikini waxing included?
faqs.answer: No. Bikini and bikini line are separate add-ons with peel-off wax.

faqs.question: Can I get waxed while pregnant?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, but tell the beautician first. Skin is more sensitive then; check with your doctor if unsure.

faqs.question: What should I arrange at home?
faqs.answer: A cool room (fan/AC), a chair or bed with space around it, and a bathroom to wash up afterwards.

faqs.question: How often should I wax?
faqs.answer: Most people repeat every 4–6 weeks. First-timers often go every 2–3 weeks for a few rounds.

half-body-waxing.name: Half Body Waxing
half-body-waxing.shortDescription: Full arms, underarms and full legs waxed at home — the most-booked waxing combo.
half-body-waxing.fullDescription: This covers the areas most women wax every month: full arms, underarms and full legs. The beautician brings her own wax heater, disposable spatulas and strips, and finishes with a soothing wipe. Choose honey wax for a lower price, Rica for sensitive skin, or chocolate roll-on for a faster, less messy session. Underarms are done with peel-off wax, which grips short hair and is easier on thin skin. Stomach, back and bikini can be added. Expect about one hour.

faqs.question: What does roll-on mean?
faqs.answer: Wax comes in a heated cartridge rolled onto skin. It spreads a thin, even layer and is less messy than pot wax.

faqs.question: Will it remove tan?
faqs.answer: Waxing lifts a thin top layer of skin, so mild tan often looks lighter. It is not a detan treatment.

faqs.question: Can I bathe after waxing?
faqs.answer: Use lukewarm water and skip soap scrubs, sun and swimming for about a day.

faqs.question: I shaved last week. Can I still book?
faqs.answer: Better to wait 2–3 more weeks. Short, stubbly hair is hard to grip.

leg-waxing.name: Leg Waxing
leg-waxing.shortDescription: Half or full leg waxing at home with honey or Rica wax.
leg-waxing.fullDescription: Book only your legs when that is all you need. Half legs means toe to knee; full legs goes from toe to the top of the thigh but does not include the bikini line. The beautician cleans the skin, applies wax in sections, removes it with strips and finishes with a calming wipe. Honey wax is the budget choice; Rica is kinder to dry or sensitive skin. A half-leg session takes about 20 minutes and full legs about 30.

faqs.question: Where does half legs stop?
faqs.answer: At the knee. Above the knee is part of full legs.

faqs.question: Is bikini line included in full legs?
faqs.answer: No, it is a separate add-on.

faqs.question: Does waxing make hair grow back thicker?
faqs.answer: No. Waxing removes hair from the root, so regrowth is usually finer. Shaving is what makes it feel coarse.

faqs.question: My skin goes red after waxing. Is that normal?
faqs.answer: Mild redness or small bumps usually settle within a few hours. Avoid hot water, sun and tight clothes that day.

faqs.question: Can you wax my eyebrows?
faqs.answer: No. We shape eyebrows with threading, which gives better control. Add threading to the same visit.

faqs.question: Is face waxing safe?
faqs.answer: Yes when done with peel-off wax by a trained beautician. Skip it if you have active acne, sunburn or cuts on the face.

faqs.question: I use retinol or acne creams. Is that a problem?
faqs.answer: Stop retinoids a few days before waxing and tell the beautician; they can make skin peel or tear.

faqs.question: Waxing or threading for upper lip?
faqs.answer: Threading suits very sensitive skin; waxing is quicker and removes fine hair too. Choose what feels better for you.

manicure-at-home.name: Manicure
manicure-at-home.shortDescription: Nail shaping, cuticle care, scrub, massage and polish for your hands — at home.

Pick a quick cut-file-polish if you only need tidy nails, a classic manicure for regular care, or a spa manicure with mask and longer massage. faqs.question: Do I need to remove old nail polish?
faqs.answer: Regular polish is removed as part of the service. Gel or acrylic removal is extra.

faqs.question: Can I bring my own nail paint?
faqs.answer: Yes, the beautician can use your polish if you prefer.

faqs.question: How long will polish last?
faqs.answer: Usually 4–7 days with normal housework. Gloves while washing utensils help it last.

faqs.question: Are tools clean?
faqs.answer: Metal tools are sanitised for every client; files and buffers are new each time.

pedicure-at-home.name: Pedicure
pedicure-at-home.shortDescription: Foot soak, nail care, heel scrub, massage and polish at home.
pedicure-at-home.fullDescription: The beautician sets up a foot tub at home and soaks your feet in warm water. She trims and shapes toenails, cleans cuticles, scrubs rough heels and dead skin, and gives a foot and calf massage before applying polish. The spa option adds a heel peel for cracked heels, a mask and a longer massage. Disposable liners or a cleaned tub are used for every client. Combine with a manicure for a lower combo price.

faqs.question: Do I need to arrange a tub?
faqs.answer: The beautician brings a foot tub; please keep a bucket of warm water and a chair ready.

faqs.question: Will it fix cracked heels?
faqs.answer: Choose the spa option with heel peel. Deep cracks need regular care; moisturise daily after the visit.

faqs.question: I have diabetes. Is pedicure safe?
faqs.answer: Tell the beautician first. She will skip sharp tools on hard skin. If you have wounds or numbness, check with your doctor.

faqs.question: Can I add waxing in the same visit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add leg or arm waxing when booking; total time increases.

faqs.question: Does the artist bring her own makeup?
faqs.answer: Yes. She brings her full kit, brushes, disposables and lashes where included. You only need a chair, a mirror and good light near a plug point.

faqs.question: How early should I book?
faqs.answer: Book at least one day ahead. During the wedding season (Nov–Feb and Apr–Jun) book three to five days ahead, as early-morning slots fill fast.

faqs.question: Can my sister and mother also get ready?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add each person as a separate booking for the same slot. The artist will plan timing so everyone is ready before you leave.

faqs.question: What is HD makeup?
faqs.answer: HD uses fine, light-reflecting products so skin looks smooth on camera and phone photos. It suits events where many photos and videos are taken.

faqs.question: Should I wash my hair before?
faqs.answer: Wash and fully dry your hair the day before or that morning. Come with a clean face, no heavy cream.

faqs.question: Can I pay cash?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pay online via Razorpay when booking or in cash after the service.

bridal-party-makeup.name: Bridal Makeup (HD / Airbrush, trial, draping, hairstyle)

faqs.question: HD or airbrush — which should I choose?
faqs.answer: HD gives a soft, natural finish and costs less. Airbrush is sprayed on, feels lighter and lasts longer in heat and sweat. For summer weddings or very long ceremonies, airbrush is a safer pick.

faqs.question: Is a trial necessary?
faqs.answer: Not required, but helpful. It lets you check shade match, eye look and hairstyle before the day. The trial fee is adjusted if you book the bridal package.

faqs.question: Will the artist come to the marriage hall or hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes, anywhere within Patna city at no extra charge. Places outside Patna have a travel charge shown before you confirm.

faqs.question: How long does bridal makeup take?
faqs.answer: Plan three to four hours including hair and draping. The artist will give a start time based on your baraat or jaimala time.

faqs.question: Do I need to pay an advance?
faqs.answer: Yes, an advance blocks the date. Pay the rest online or in cash after the service.

faqs.question: What should I keep ready?
faqs.answer: Clean, moisturised face, washed dry hair, jewellery, safety pins, outfit and dupatta. Share outfit photos and reference looks a few days before.

Choose HD for a natural finish or airbrush for longer wear. The same package works for a reception or cocktail evening. If you are also booking bridal makeup with us, ask for the combined booking so one artist handles both days.

faqs.question: How is engagement makeup different from bridal?
faqs.answer: It is usually lighter, with softer eyes and lips, and takes less time. Products and finish (HD or airbrush) are similar.

faqs.question: Can I use this for my reception or tilak?
faqs.answer: Yes. The package covers any single function. Tell us the event and timing while booking.

faqs.question: Do you do makeup for the groom?
faqs.answer: Groom grooming is not part of this package. Ask support; we can add a basic groom touch-up where an artist is available.

faqs.question: Can I book engagement and wedding together?
faqs.answer: Yes. The combo keeps the same artist for both days and includes one trial.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: Pay an advance online through Razorpay to block the date. Pay the rest online or in cash after the service.

faqs.question: How often should I get my AC serviced?
faqs.answer: Before summer starts and once more mid-season if the AC runs daily. In dusty areas of Patna, clean the filter yourself every 2–3 weeks.

faqs.question: Will water spill in my room?
faqs.answer: No. The technician hangs a cleaning bag under the indoor unit and covers the floor and furniture before washing.

faqs.question: Does service fix low cooling?
faqs.answer: It helps if dirt is the cause. If gas is low or a part is faulty, the technician will tell you the cost before doing any extra work.

faqs.question: Is the price same for split and window AC?
faqs.answer: Yes, one price for both types.

faqs.question: Is there a warranty?

ac-gas-refill.fullDescription: If your AC runs but the air is not cold, or ice forms on the pipes, gas may have leaked. faqs.question: How do I know my AC needs gas?
faqs.answer: Weak cooling even after cleaning, outdoor fan running but little cold air, or frost on the pipes. The technician confirms with a pressure gauge before refilling.

faqs.question: Does gas finish over time?
faqs.answer: Not normally. Gas runs in a closed loop, so low gas usually means a leak. That is why we check for leaks first.

faqs.question: Which gas will you fill?
faqs.answer: The same gas your AC was built for — R32, R410A or R22. It is written on the outdoor unit sticker. Mixing gases damages the AC.

faqs.question: What if the leak is in the coil?
faqs.answer: The technician shows you the leak and gives a written price for coil repair or replacement before any work.

faqs.answer: Many new inverter ACs work without one, but check your AC manual. If voltage drops often in your area, a stabiliser is safer.

faqs.answer: About 2 hours for a split AC and 1 hour for a window AC, if the wall and power point are ready.

faqs.question: Can you install it at my new house?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose the shifting combo or book installation separately for the new address.

faqs.question: Can the control board be repaired instead of replaced?
faqs.answer: Often yes. Component-level repair usually costs much less than a new board. The technician will suggest which is better.

faqs.question: Why is there loud noise during spin?
faqs.answer: Usually worn drum bearings, loose shock absorbers or an uneven load. Bearings need drum dismantling and take a few hours.

faqs.question: Why does my machine smell?
faqs.answer: Detergent residue and dirt build up in the gasket and filter. A jet cleaning service removes it.

faqs.answer: Common causes are a faulty lid switch, belt, clutch, motor or board. The technician tests each and quotes the right part.

faqs.question: Water doesn't drain. Is it serious?
faqs.answer: Often just a blocked filter or pipe, fixed during the visit. If the drain motor has failed, it needs replacement.

faqs.question: My display went dead after a power cut.
faqs.answer: Voltage spikes often damage the control board. Many boards can be repaired. We suggest using a stabiliser afterwards.

faqs.question: The machine shakes a lot.
faqs.answer: Usually uneven load, poor leveling or worn damper rods. Leveling is free; new dampers are charged.

faqs.question: Do you use original parts?

faqs.question: The spin tub doesn't spin.
faqs.answer: Check the lid is fully closed. If it is, the lid switch, spin timer, brake or spin motor may be faulty.

faqs.question: Water leaks from the bottom.
faqs.answer: Often a worn drain valve, drain bellow or cracked pipe. These are low-cost parts.

faqs.question: Rats cut the wires. Can you fix it?
faqs.answer: Yes. We rewire and can fit a rat mesh at the base to prevent it happening again.

faqs.question: Is it worth repairing a semi-automatic machine?
faqs.answer: Usually yes. Most parts cost under ₹2,000, much less than a new machine.
