side-by-side-refrigerator-service.fullDescription: Side-by-side and French-door fridges are large (500 litres and up), mostly inverter, and often have water dispensers and ice makers. Repairs need more time and care. Our technician reads error codes, checks the inverter board, fans, defrost system and water line, and tests for gas leaks. Parts for these models are often brand-specific, so we quote them after checking availability. Gas charging and common parts follow our rate card.
bullets: Error-code reading and board check
Fan, defrost and water-line check
Leak test and gas charging
Brand part sourcing with quote first
90-day warranty on gas/compressor work

inverter-pcb-repair.title: Inverter PCB repair
inverter-pcb-repair.description: Board repair and test (may need workshop)

water-dispenser-ice-maker-fix.title: Water dispenser / ice-maker fix
water-dispenser-ice-maker-fix.description: Valve or line repair; part charged extra

excludes: Brand PCB/compressor (often ₹6,000+; up to ₹16,000 at brand centres)

faqs.question: Can a side-by-side fridge be repaired at home?
faqs.answer: Most jobs, yes. Board repairs may need a day at the workshop.

faqs.question: Why are parts costlier?
faqs.answer: These models use brand-specific inverter boards and compressors that are not sold locally in Patna.

faqs.question: How long for a part to arrive?
faqs.answer: Common parts same day; brand parts can take a few days. We tell you before ordering.

faqs.question: Do I need to empty the fridge?
faqs.answer: For gas or compressor work, yes. Keep a cooler box ready for 3–4 hours.

faqs.question: Can a power cut damage the board?
faqs.answer: Voltage swings can. A stabiliser helps protect the board.

inverter-refrigerator-service.name: Inverter Refrigerator Service
inverter-refrigerator-service.shortDescription: Repair for inverter-compressor fridges: board, compressor and gas work by trained technicians.
inverter-refrigerator-service.fullDescription: Inverter fridges use a variable-speed compressor run by an electronic board. When cooling stops, the fault may be the board, the compressor or gas. Our technician checks voltage, reads error codes, tests the board and compressor separately, and checks gas pressure, so you only replace what has failed. Board repair is offered before replacement where possible. Most inverter fridges use R600a gas, which needs careful handling; our technicians follow safe charging steps.
bullets: Board and compressor tested separately
Board repair offered before replacement
Safe R600a gas charging with leak test
Fixed prices for board repair and gas
90-day warranty on gas, compressor and board work

faqs.question: How do I know my fridge is inverter?
faqs.answer: Check the label inside or the box; it often says "Inverter" or "Smart Inverter". The technician can confirm.

faqs.question: Can the board be repaired instead of replaced?
faqs.answer: Often yes, and it costs less. We try repair first and tell you if replacement is needed.

faqs.question: Does an inverter fridge need a stabiliser?
faqs.answer: Many have a wide voltage range, but in areas with heavy fluctuation a stabiliser helps protect the board.

faqs.question: Is the compressor covered by brand warranty?
faqs.answer: Many brands give long compressor warranties. Check your card first; we'll tell you if it looks like a brand claim.

faqs.question: What gas do you use?
faqs.answer: The same gas written on your fridge label, usually R600a or R134a.

tv-diagnosis-repair-visit.name: TV Diagnosis & Troubleshooting
tv-diagnosis-repair-visit.shortDescription: Technician visits, finds the fault in your LED/Smart TV and gives a written quote before any repair.
tv-diagnosis-repair-visit.fullDescription: Our technician comes home with a tester and common spares and checks power, display, sound, ports and smart-TV settings. You get a clear explanation of the fault and a price for the fix before work starts. Small fixes such as loose cables, input/source settings, remote pairing, Wi-Fi or app problems and software reset are done in the same visit. If the repair needs a board, backlight or panel part, the visit fee is adjusted in the final repair bill. We service LED, LCD, Smart, QLED and OLED TVs of all major brands. CRT (old box) TVs are not covered.
bullets: Full check of power, picture, sound, HDMI/USB ports and remote
Smart-TV fixes: Wi-Fi, apps, software update, factory reset
Written repair quote before any part is replaced
Visit fee adjusted if you go ahead with the repair
All brands: Sony, Samsung, LG, Mi, OnePlus, Vu, TCL, Panasonic and others

tv-check-up-visit.title: TV check-up visit
tv-check-up-visit.description: Diagnosis + quote; fee adjusted against repair

smart-tv-software-and-settings-fix.description: App/Wi-Fi/update/factory reset, channel tuning, remote pairing

minor-repair-no-major-board.description: E.g. fuse, capacitor, loose connector, power cord

CRT TVs, soundbars and set-top boxes not serviced

faqs.question: Is the visit fee extra if I get the repair done?
faqs.answer: No. The ₹199 check-up fee is adjusted in the final repair bill if you approve the quote.

faqs.question: Do you repair old CRT (box) TVs?
faqs.answer: No. We service flat-panel TVs only: LED, LCD, Smart, QLED and OLED.

faqs.question: Can a cracked screen be fixed?
faqs.answer: A cracked panel cannot be repaired, only replaced. Panel cost is often close to a new TV, so the technician will tell you honestly if replacing the TV makes more sense.

faqs.question: Will the TV be repaired at home?
faqs.answer: Most faults are fixed at home. Some board-level repairs need bench work; then we take the TV or board to our workshop with your consent and return it.

faqs.question: My TV is still under brand warranty. Should I book?
faqs.answer: Contact the brand service centre first. Opening the TV through an outside technician may void the brand warranty.

faqs.question: Should I repair an old TV?
faqs.answer: If the TV is over 8–10 years old or the repair is close to a new TV's price, we will suggest replacement.

tv-wall-mounting-setup.name: TV Wall Mounting & Setup
tv-wall-mounting-setup.shortDescription: Safe wall mounting of your LED/Smart TV with drilling, level check, cable tidying and first-time setup.
tv-wall-mounting-setup.fullDescription: Our technician checks the wall, marks the right viewing height, drills and fixes the bracket, and hangs the TV level. We then connect power, set-top box, soundbar or HDMI devices, tune channels and sign in to Wi-Fi and apps if needed. Price depends on screen size. Bring the bracket that came with your TV, or choose a package that includes a standard fixed bracket. Uninstalling a TV from one wall (for shifting) is also available. Concealed wiring, extra cables and wall-chasing are quoted separately.
bullets: Bracket fitting on brick or concrete wall, with level check
TV hung and locked safely; area cleaned after drilling
Connections: power, set-top box, soundbar, HDMI devices
Smart-TV setup: Wi-Fi, apps, channel tuning
Choose your own bracket or a fixed bracket from us

excludes: Bracket (unless the bracket package is chosen)
Mounting on wooden panel/gypsum (needs special anchors)

faqs.question: Do you bring the bracket?
faqs.answer: Most new TVs come with a bracket from the brand. If you don't have one, choose the "with bracket" add-on and we bring a standard fixed bracket.

faqs.question: Can you mount on a gypsum or wooden panel wall?
faqs.answer: Yes, with suitable anchors or backing. The technician checks on site; extra hardware is charged at actual cost.

faqs.question: My brand offers free installation. Should I book?
faqs.answer: If your new TV comes with free brand installation, use it first. Book us for shifting, re-mounting or when the brand visit is delayed.

faqs.question: Will you hide the wires?
faqs.answer: We tidy cables with clips. Concealing wires inside the wall or a conduit is a separate job and quoted on site.

faqs.question: How long does it take?
faqs.answer: Usually 45–60 minutes. Large TVs above 65 inch may take longer and need two people.

tv-backlight-repair.name: Backlight & Screen Flicker Repair
tv-backlight-repair.shortDescription: Fix for dark screen with sound, dim or flickering picture by replacing failed LED backlight strips.
tv-backlight-repair.fullDescription: If your TV has sound but a black or very dim picture, or the screen flickers or shows dark patches, the LED backlight strips are often at fault. Our technician first confirms the fault with a torch test and strip tester. The panel is then opened carefully in a dust-free area and all strips of the set are replaced, not just the dead one, so the brightness stays even. Price depends on screen size and brand. Cracked panels, vertical lines and T-CON faults are not backlight issues and are quoted separately.
bullets: Fault confirmed before opening (torch test and LED tester)
Full strip set replaced for even brightness
Backlight driver/power board checked at the same time
Price fixed by screen size before work starts
Repair warranty on replaced strips (see FAQs)

50-55-inch.title: 50–55 inch
50-55-inch.description: Full strip set, two technicians, at home or workshop (standard-quality strips + labour)

faqs.question: How do I know it's a backlight problem?
faqs.answer: If you hear sound and see a faint picture when shining a torch close to the screen, the backlight has most likely failed.

faqs.question: Why replace all strips if only one is dead?
faqs.answer: Strips age together. Replacing the full set keeps brightness even and avoids another opening soon.

faqs.question: Can it be done at home?
faqs.answer: Up to 43 inch is usually done at home on a clean table. Larger TVs may be taken to our workshop with your approval.

faqs.question: Is there a warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes, replaced strips carry a TiptoBook repair warranty.

faqs.question: Is it worth repairing?
faqs.answer: Backlight repair usually costs far less than a new panel. For TVs over 8 years old, we will tell you if replacement makes more sense.

tv-motherboard-audio-repair.name: Motherboard & Audio IC Repair
tv-motherboard-audio-repair.shortDescription: Chip-level repair or replacement of TV main board, power board and sound IC for no-power, restart and no-sound faults.
tv-motherboard-audio-repair.fullDescription: When a TV will not switch on, keeps restarting, is stuck on the logo, has no sound or a crackling sound, the fault is often on the main board (motherboard), power board or audio amplifier IC. Our technician tests the boards at home. Where possible we repair at component level (capacitor, IC, regulator, software re-flash), which costs much less than a new board. If the board cannot be repaired, we quote a tested replacement board for your model. Faulty speakers, HDMI and USB ports are also handled. You approve the price before any work.

Component repair first; full board replacement only if needed
Software re-flash for logo-stuck or boot-loop TVs
Speaker, HDMI and USB port repair

motherboard-replacement-fitting-only.title: Motherboard replacement (fitting only)
motherboard-replacement-fitting-only.description: Tested board for your model + fitting and setup; board charged separately at quoted price

faqs.question: Can a TV motherboard be repaired or must it be replaced?
faqs.answer: Many faults (capacitors, power ICs, corrupted software) can be repaired at chip level. We replace the board only when repair isn't possible or reliable.

faqs.question: Why does it take a day or two sometimes?
faqs.answer: Chip-level work needs bench tools. With your approval we take the board (not always the TV) to our workshop and refit it.

faqs.question: My TV is stuck on the brand logo. Is that the motherboard?
faqs.answer: Often it is corrupted software or memory on the main board. A re-flash may fix it without replacing the board.

faqs.question: No sound but picture is fine. What could it be?
faqs.answer: Settings, a faulty speaker, loose connector or a failed audio amplifier IC. The technician checks with an external speaker first.

faqs.question: What warranty do I get?
faqs.answer: Repaired boards and fitted parts carry a TiptoBook repair warranty.

faqs.question: Was my TV hit by lightning or voltage surge?
faqs.answer: Surge damage can affect several boards. Quotes are given only after inspection; we also suggest a stabiliser or surge protector.

geyser-checkup-descaling.name: Geyser Check-up & Descaling
geyser-checkup-descaling.shortDescription: Technician visits, finds why your geyser is not heating or tripping, and cleans out scale for faster heating.
geyser-checkup-descaling.fullDescription: Hard water in Patna leaves white scale inside geyser tanks and on the heating element. Over time the geyser takes longer to heat, uses more power, and may trip the MCB. Our technician first checks power supply, element, thermostat, wiring and earthing. For a full service, the tank is drained, the element is taken out and descaled, the tank is flushed, and the outer body is cleaned. You get a clear quote before any part is replaced. We work on electric storage and instant geysers of all common brands. Gas geysers are not covered.
bullets: Fault diagnosis: power, element, thermostat, wiring, earthing check
Tank draining and flushing to remove sediment
Element descaling and outer body cleaning (service package)
Written quote before any part replacement
Visit fee adjusted if you go ahead with repair

geyser-check-up-diagnosis-only.title: Geyser check-up (diagnosis only)

storage-geyser-service-10-25-l.title: Storage geyser service (10–25 L)

large-storage-geyser-service-35-50-l.title: Large storage geyser service (35–50 L)

excludes: Spare parts (element, thermostat, gasket, valves, anode rod)

faqs.question: How often should I get my geyser serviced?
faqs.answer: Once a year, ideally before winter (October–November). In hard-water areas, scale builds faster, so yearly descaling keeps heating fast and power use lower.

faqs.question: Is the check-up fee extra if I get the repair done?
faqs.answer: No. The check-up fee is adjusted in the final repair bill if you approve the repair.

faqs.question: Do you service gas geysers?
faqs.answer: No. We currently handle electric storage and instant geysers only.

faqs.question: Will my geyser be unusable during service?
faqs.answer: Yes, for about an hour. Power and water supply to the geyser are switched off while the tank is drained and cleaned.

faqs.question: My geyser is under brand warranty. Should I book?
faqs.answer: Check with the brand first. Racold, for example, gives multi-year cover on element and tank. Our service may affect brand warranty claims for internal parts.

geyser-element-thermostat-replacement.name: Heating Element & Thermostat Replacement
geyser-element-thermostat-replacement.shortDescription: Geyser not heating, overheating, or tripping power? We test and replace the faulty element or thermostat.
geyser-element-thermostat-replacement.fullDescription: Most geyser faults come from two parts. A burnt or scaled heating element means no hot water or a tripping MCB. A faulty thermostat means water stays cold, gets too hot, or the cut-off keeps triggering. Our technician tests both with a meter, shows you the faulty part, and quotes the part price before replacing it. The labour charge below covers removal, fitting a new gasket, refilling, and a heating test. Parts are billed at the listed rate, with local and branded options where available.
bullets: Meter test of element, thermostat and safety cut-out
Faulty part shown to you before replacement
Part price told upfront; local or branded choice
New gasket fitted, tank refilled, leak and heating test
Old part handed back on request

thermostat-replacement-labour.title: Thermostat replacement (labour)
thermostat-replacement-labour.description: Test, replace main or safety thermostat, test

heating-element-replacement-instant-geys.title: Heating element replacement, instant geyser (1–6 L)

heating-element-replacement-storage-geys.title: Heating element replacement, storage geyser (10–50 L)
heating-element-replacement-storage-geys.description: Drain tank, remove flange, descale, fit element + new gasket, refill, test

element-plus-thermostat-combo.title: Element + thermostat combo
element-plus-thermostat-combo.description: Both parts replaced in one visit

excludes: New MCB or house wiring work (book electrician)

faqs.question: How do I know if it is the element or the thermostat?
faqs.answer: No heat and MCB trips usually means element. Water too hot, too cold, or light on with no heating often points to thermostat. The technician confirms by meter test.

faqs.question: Are parts original brand parts?
faqs.answer: You choose. We offer local-compatible parts and branded parts where available. Prices for both are shown before fitting.

faqs.question: My geyser is 8–10 years old. Repair or replace?
faqs.answer: If the tank is leaking or rusted, replace. If only the element or thermostat failed and the tank is sound, repair is usually cheaper.

faqs.question: Is my geyser's brand warranty still valid?
faqs.answer: Many brands cover the element for several years. Check your warranty card first; the brand may replace it free.

geyser-installation-uninstallation.name: Geyser Installation & Uninstallation
geyser-installation-uninstallation.shortDescription: Wall-mounting and plumbing hookup for new instant or storage geysers, plus safe removal of old units.
geyser-installation-uninstallation.fullDescription: Bought a new geyser or shifting house? Our technician drills and mounts the geyser on a solid wall, connects inlet and outlet pipes, fits the safety or pressure valve, connects power to an earthed socket, fills the tank, and runs a heating and leak test. Storage geysers (10–25 L) are heavier and need stronger anchoring than small instant units (1–6 L). For removal, we isolate power and water, drain the tank, detach the unit and cap the pipes. Pipes, valves and wiring are billed separately if needed.

Inlet/outlet connection and safety valve fitting
Earthing check and plug-point connection test
Fill, heat and leak test before we leave
Uninstall: drain, detach, cap pipes safely

Tile drilling damage on fragile tiles

faqs.question: Does the brand install free?
faqs.answer: Some brands include free installation with a new geyser. Check your invoice. If not, or if you want it sooner, book us.

faqs.question: Do I need to buy pipes and valves?
faqs.answer: New geysers usually come with a bracket and safety valve. Pipes are often extra. The technician will tell you on arrival and bill only what is used.

faqs.question: Instant or storage — which needs more work?
faqs.answer: Storage geysers are heavier when full and need a strong wall and good anchoring. Instant geysers are smaller and quicker to mount.

faqs.question: What power point is needed?
faqs.answer: A dedicated 15/16 A earthed socket for storage geysers. Instant geysers (3 kW) also need a 15/16 A point. We do not run new wiring under this service.

faqs.question: Can you install on a hollow or weak wall?
faqs.answer: No. For safety, storage geysers go on a solid brick or concrete wall only.

geyser-leakage-valve-repair.name: Tank Leakage & Valve Repair
geyser-leakage-valve-repair.shortDescription: Water dripping from your geyser? We fix leaking valves, pipes and gaskets, and check if the tank is damaged.
geyser-leakage-valve-repair.fullDescription: A dripping geyser wastes water and can be unsafe near live wiring. Most leaks come from a worn safety or pressure valve, loose inlet/outlet pipes, or an old gasket around the element flange. Our technician switches off power, finds the leak source, and replaces the worn part. If the inner tank itself is cracked or rusted through, we tell you honestly: tank replacement costs a large share of a new geyser, and replacing the unit may make more sense. Constant dripping from the valve can also mean high water pressure, which we check.

Pressure-reducing valve for the house line

faqs.question: Water drips from the small valve when the geyser heats. Is that normal?
faqs.answer: A few drops while heating can be normal; the valve releases pressure. A steady flow or drip when the geyser is off means the valve needs replacing.

faqs.question: Can a leaking tank be welded?
faqs.answer: We do not weld tanks; it is not safe for a pressurised heater. We replace the tank or advise buying a new geyser.

faqs.question: Is a leaking geyser dangerous?
faqs.answer: It can be if water reaches the wiring. Switch off the geyser at the MCB or socket and close the inlet valve until the technician arrives.

faqs.question: Is tank replacement worth it?
faqs.answer: Compare costs. A new tank plus labour can approach the price of a small new geyser. Many brands give 5–7 years tank warranty, so check that first.

new-home-construction.name: New Home Construction

The quote lists the cement, steel, brick, tile and fitting brands used. Payments are split by stage, such as foundation, slab and finishing, so you only pay for work completed. Drawings, approvals and boundary wall can be added separately.

faqs.question: Is the per-sq-ft rate final?
faqs.answer: No. It is a starting estimate. The final rate is fixed after a site visit, soil check and your material choices, and is written into the agreement.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: Patna city and nearby areas such as Danapur, Phulwari, Bihta and Naubatpur. Other Bihar towns on request.

faqs.question: How is payment done?
faqs.answer: In stages linked to work done, for example foundation, plinth, each slab, brickwork and finishing. Pay online via Razorpay or by bank transfer.

faqs.question: Why might foundation cost more?
faqs.answer: Some Patna plots have soft river-belt soil. These may need deeper footing or piling, which is quoted separately after a soil test.

faqs.question: How long does a 1,000 sq ft house take?
faqs.answer: Typically several months depending on floors, weather and labour; festival and harvest seasons can slow work. Your contractor shares a stage timeline.

faqs.question: What does a 1,500 sq ft standard house cost?
faqs.answer: Roughly ₹27–32 lakh in Patna at standard finish, per public 2026 estimates. Your quote depends on design and soil.

faqs.question: Is the design consultation free?

faqs.question: Can I do only one room or the kitchen?

faqs.question: Which materials are used?
faqs.answer: The quote names the board type (e.g. BWP/MR ply), laminate and hinge/channel brands so you can compare. Upgrades are priced per item.

faqs.question: How long does a 2BHK take?
faqs.answer: Usually a few weeks after design approval, depending on scope and factory lead time. Your designer shares the schedule.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: In stages: booking, start of production and handover. Pay online via Razorpay or bank transfer.

faqs.question: What do you need from me?
faqs.answer: Plot length and width, road side and direction, number of floors, and the rooms you want. A rough sketch or photo of the plot helps.

faqs.question: Is the plan Vastu-compliant?
faqs.answer: If you ask, rooms are placed following common Vastu guidance. Tell us your priorities, like kitchen or pooja room direction.

faqs.question: How many changes can I ask for?
faqs.answer: Minor revisions (up to three is common) are included. Big layout changes after approval are charged.

faqs.question: Will this plan get municipal approval?
faqs.answer: Drawings follow standard setbacks, but sanction depends on Patna Municipal Corporation/authority rules. Approval fees and liaison are separate.

faqs.question: Can my contractor build from this?
faqs.answer: The floor plan alone is for layout. For building, take the complete set with working, structural and electrical/plumbing drawings.

faqs.answer: By the ceiling area in square feet. Cove designs and drops may add running-foot charges, which are listed in the quote.

faqs.question: Gypsum or POP: which is better?
faqs.answer: Gypsum is faster and smoother with less mess. POP suits curved or detailed designs but takes longer to set and finish.

faqs.question: Can I use false ceiling in the bathroom?
faqs.answer: PVC panels are a better choice for bathrooms and balconies because they resist moisture. Gypsum needs a moisture-resistant board there.

faqs.question: Are lights included?
faqs.answer: The price includes cut-outs for lights. Fixtures and wiring points are charged separately so you can pick your own brand.

faqs.question: Is painting included?
faqs.answer: Primer is included. The final paint coat is quoted separately unless your package says otherwise.

faqs.question: Will it reduce room height?
faqs.answer: Usually by a few inches, depending on design. The technician checks your ceiling height during the visit.

faqs.question: Do I need to vacate the house?
faqs.answer: Not for a single bathroom or kitchen job. For full-home renovation, staying elsewhere for part of the time is often easier.

faqs.question: Why do old bathrooms cost more?
faqs.answer: Homes older than 10–15 years often need new waterproofing and plumbing lines, which adds labour and material cost.

faqs.question: Can I supply my own tiles and fittings?
faqs.answer: Yes. The quote then covers labour and civil materials only, and you control brand and price.

faqs.question: Is there a warranty?
faqs.answer: Workmanship and waterproofing cover terms are written in your quote.

faqs.question: How is the final price fixed?
faqs.answer: After the site visit, you get an itemised quote. Extra work found during demolition is shown and approved by you before it is done.

faqs.question: How do you calculate the price?
faqs.answer: We measure every wall and ceiling to be painted, minus large doors and windows, and multiply by the per-sq-ft rate of your paint grade. You get the breakup in writing before work starts.

faqs.question: Is the inspection visit free?
faqs.answer: The visit is free inside Patna city limits. Outside, a small travel charge applies and is adjusted against the final bill if you book.

faqs.question: Can I buy the paint myself?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can do labour-only at a lower rate. You then own any shade mismatch or shortage, so we suggest letting us source it.

faqs.question: How long does a 2 BHK take?
faqs.answer: Usually 4–6 working days for interiors, depending on wall condition, putty work and drying time between coats.

faqs.question: Do you fix damp walls?
faqs.answer: Painting over damp only peels again. We point out seepage during the visit and quote waterproofing separately before painting.

faqs.question: Do I need to empty the rooms?
faqs.answer: No. We move light furniture to the centre and cover it. Please pack fragile items and wall hangings beforehand.

interior-wall-painting.shortDescription: Paint just one wall, one room or a few rooms, including texture or accent walls, at a fixed starting price.
interior-wall-painting.fullDescription: Not every home needs a full repaint. Book us for a single wall, a bedroom, the kitchen, a bathroom or a balcony. The painter covers your furniture, scrapes loose paint, fills small cracks, applies primer and two coats in the shade you pick. For a feature look, choose an accent wall in a bold colour or a texture finish such as rustic, sand or stencil designs. Small jobs finish in a day; a full room usually takes two days because each coat needs to dry. Final price is confirmed on site if the wall is larger or damaged.

faqs.question: What if my room is bigger than the package?
faqs.answer: The painter measures before starting. Extra area is charged at the same per-sq-ft rate, and you approve the new total before work begins.

faqs.question: Can you match my existing wall colour?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you share the shade name or code. Otherwise we match by eye using shade cards; an exact match on old, faded paint is not guaranteed.

faqs.question: How long before I can use the room?
faqs.answer: Emulsion is touch-dry in a few hours. Keep furniture off the walls for a day and avoid washing the wall for about two weeks.

faqs.question: What textures can I choose?
faqs.answer: Common options are rustic, sand, stucco-look, combing and stencil patterns. The painter brings a sample catalogue; complex designer finishes cost more.

faqs.question: Is there a smell?
faqs.answer: We use low-odour water-based emulsions by default. Keep windows open; most people sleep in the room the next night.
